caption:
Most owners calculate ad spend. Almost none calculate the cost of slow follow-up.

The Revenue Calculator takes three numbers: monthly leads, close rate, average job value. It shows what's sitting on the table while leads wait.

Industry research shows only 17% of service businesses answer a lead within an hour, and responding within 5 minutes can double close rates. The calculator turns that gap into a dollar figure for your business.

Free. No signup. No card.
